meta.profile: MBBS 2019-20 session, results Sep 2026, internship starting Oct–Nov 2026, no work experience, USD 30k budget, goal: US residency

51st BCS: if he applied, watch bpsc.gov.bd for the November MCQ date and admit card; keep the BMDC (temporary) registration and the exam-dates certificate ready for the viva

November deadlines: OIST 15 Nov (23:59 JST), Sanger 24 Nov (09:00 GMT; ask whether MBBS qualifies), ETH ESOP 30 Nov (11:59 CET), Yenching 30 Nov (09:00 Beijing)

1 Dec group: HKPFS (RGC noon, universities 11:59pm HKT; start deferrable to 31 Jan 2028 — best fit), A*STAR SINGA Aug 2027, Max Planck Schools, JHU/Harvard PhD, Eu-HEM; confirm Oxford MSc GHSE and Neurasmus dates on their official pages (not re-verified this week)
Erasmus Mundus windows opening: HYGIEIA 16 Nov, LIVE_Innov 18 Nov (closes 20 Jan), IDOH 1 Dec — finish one master motivation letter now and adapt it; NOHA closes 15 Dec 23:59 GMT

Key: Commonwealth 2027 missed (UGC closed 30 Sep); IDOH now closes 31 Jan 2027; Oxford health MSc deadline 1 Dec; FCPS Part I moved to 1 Dec/1 Jun; Ireland doesn't recognise the Bangladesh internship; new: Erasmus Mundus PHID and LIVE, NUS SPH PhD, HKPFS, LSHTM Fund, SINGA, Mayo research fellows. US: H-1B $100k fee still blocked; Bangladesh on immigrant-visa pause and B1/B2 visa bond.

Weekly sweep: 46 items checked, 13 changed, 20 added (102 routes total). Key: 51st BCS circular read — internship not required, temporary BMDC registration needed only at viva; US immigrant-visa pause for Bangladesh lifted 21 Aug 2026 (board corrected); H-1B $100k fee blocked again by a court on 30 Sep (proclamation runs to Sep 2027); Germany's Kenntnisprüfung becomes the default route from 1 Nov 2026; Eiffel 2027 call open (Campus France 6 Jan 2027); NUS SPH PhD needs a confirmed advisor and has no funded Jan intake; Knight-Hennessy 2027 marked closed. New: OIST, Imperial President's, ISTA, Sanger, Edinburgh PhDs; NOHA and imAGEin Erasmus Mundus; Master Mind, Irish GOI-IES, Czech, Mahidol, AKF scholarships; NIH Visiting Fellow, ECFMG J-1 research sponsorship, Arizona and GWU research fellowships; UNFPA and Gavi internships. New: IMIM, SpaceMed, Neurasmus, HYGIEIA, MemBioMed, Eu-HEM and 10 more health-adjacent Erasmus Mundus programmes; Yenching, HBKU, Chula LINK, MEXT university recommendation, Glasgow GREAT; Max Planck Schools, MBZUAI, Melbourne MDHS; Hartford and Jefferson research fellowships. Weekly sweep: 34 items checked, 9 changed, 1 added (120 routes total). Confirmed unchanged: Imperial President's (2 Nov), OIST (15 Nov), Sanger (24 Nov), ETH ESOP and Yenching (30 Nov), HKPFS, SINGA, Gates, NOHA (15 Dec), HYGIEIA, KAUST. US: no new ECFMG/USMLE rule changes; NRMP Oct newsletter changes interview-invitation rules only; H-1B $100k fee still blocked. Not verified this week (official pages served old content): Oxford MSc GHSE and Neurasmus 1 Dec dates, Edinburgh 2027 scholarship dates. Bangladeshi doctor and USMLE groups repost from the official sites above. The sweep watches the originals, so every repost is caught at its source.

paths.name: 51st BCS (Special), health cadre
paths.time: 200-mark written MCQ (BPSC says it may be held in November 2026; no date yet) + 100-mark viva
paths.dt: Applications closed 25 Oct 2026 (fee by 28 Oct); written MCQ expected Nov 2026 — date not announced as of 1 Nov
paths.note: About 4,700 Assistant Surgeon + 300 Assistant Dental Surgeon posts (numbers may change). Age 21–32 on 1 Sep 2026. Internship completion is not a requirement. BMDC registration (temporary internship registration is enough) must be shown at the viva, with a medical certificate. Results-awaited candidates may apply provisionally if all written exams finished by 25 Oct; at viva they must show a certificate with exam start/end dates, or candidacy is cancelled. BPSC enforces this: 23 candidates of the 48th BCS were suspended on 22 Sep 2026 for missing BMDC certificates. 200-mark MCQ (−0.5 per wrong answer) + 100-mark viva; no separate prelim. Application window closed 25 Oct 2026 with no extension; press counted 15,000+ applicants. If he applied, watch bpsc.gov.bd for the MCQ date and admit card; as of 1 Nov BPSC still says only 'may be held in November 2026'. Subject-wise syllabus for the 200-mark MCQ published on bpsc.gov.bd on 30 Sep 2026; written-exam date still not announced. Government service needs an NOC to go abroad.
paths.change: Application window closed 25 Oct (no extension), so new applications are no longer possible; for those who applied, the November MCQ date is still unannounced as of 1 Nov.

paths.name: 52nd regular BCS
paths.note: No circular as of 1 Nov 2026. Press and coaching pages still say BPSC is targeting November 2026 (not verified with BPSC). Correction to last week: Prothom Alo (12 Sep 2026) reports Prof. Mohammad Nazmuzzaman Bhuian took the oath as PSC chairman on 6 Sep 2026 and has started duties, so the chairman change happened in early September rather than being new. Treat any November date as uncertain.
paths.change: Correction: the PSC leadership change was in early September (new chairman Prof. Mohammad Nazmuzzaman Bhuian sworn in 6 Sep 2026); still no 52nd circular as of 1 Nov.

paths.name: FCPS Part I (BCPS)
paths.cost: Tk 11,000 new / Tk 10,000 reseat (BCPS fee table, July 2025)
paths.time: Exams start 1 Dec (Jan session) and 1 Jun (Jul session)
paths.dt: Jan 2027 session: register 11 Oct – 3 Nov 2026 (not open to him); first realistic sitting ≈1 Dec 2027 (Jan 2028 session)
paths.note: Requires permanent BMDC registration (stated in the 11 Oct 2026 notice), so the internship must be finished. Jan 2027 session: online registration and payment 11 Oct – 3 Nov 2026, fee Tk 6,000, admit cards ≈20 Nov, exam from ≈1 Dec 2026 (scan partly garbled). One subject per session. A revised Part-I question pattern applies from July 2026.

paths.name: MD/MS residency (BMU)
paths.dt: March 2027 session applications closed (admit-card notice 25 Oct 2026); March 2028 is his realistic intake
paths.note: BMU admission notice dated 17 Sep 2026 for the March 2027 Phase-A residency test, with an online form live; dates and eligibility PDFs couldn't be read. Past cycles required a completed internship, so March 2028 is the earliest realistic intake (likely, not verified).

paths.name: USMLE + ECFMG certification
paths.dt: 2027 Pathways close 31 Jan 2027; 2028 Pathways not announced
paths.note: Step 1 and Step 2 CK plus a Pathway (OET Medicine) are required; with no licence, Pathway 6 (Mini-CEX) is the realistic one. IMGs now apply for USMLE via FSMB (since 12 Jan 2026). Step 2 CK is the score screen. Check the school's ECFMG Sponsor Note on wdoms.org. NRMP 2027 Match: registration opened 15 Sep 2026 (multi-factor login now mandatory), registration deadline 29 Jan 2027, ECFMG requirements due by the rank-list deadline 3 Mar 2027, Match Day 19 Mar 2027 — too early for him; target 2028 or 2029. Policy: the 75-country immigrant-visa pause (Bangladesh included) is no longer in effect since 21 Aug 2026 (court order in CLINIC v. Rubio) — good news for a later green card, but litigation continues. The DHS rule ending J-1 'duration of status' (due 15 Sep 2026) was postponed by a court; ECFMG is watching. As of 1 Nov the only recent ECFMG news post is still the D/S postponement (23 Sep); no 2028 Pathways, OET or fee news. NRMP published three new transition-to-residency data reports on 14 Oct (no rule change). USMLE now uses new software with 30-minute blocks (Step 1: 14 × 30 min since 14 May 2026; Step 2 CK: 16 × 30 min since 7 May 2026) — practise with the new tutorial. Bangladesh is not on the US travel-ban list. NRMP's Oct 2026 Illuminator: programs must give applicants at least 48 hours to answer interview invitations and can't over-invite; a voluntary rank-list lock pilot runs in IM, Pediatrics and Vascular Surgery — no IMG-specific rule change.

paths.name: Saudi SMLE + SCFHS GP classification
paths.note: Classification asks for an internship certificate. Some employers also want a year of experience after the internship.

paths.name: Qatar DHP GP licence
paths.note: MOPH's January 2026 circular requires an internship year or 1 year of licensed experience. A supervised GP category exists. The claim that 5 years are required is wrong for GP.

paths.name: UAE (DHA, DOH, MOHAP) GP licence
paths.note: About 2 years of post-internship experience for GP. A missing internship adds another 2 years (Unified PQR).

paths.name: Oman, Kuwait and Bahrain
paths.note: Oman about 2 years of post-qualification experience plus MOH exam; Kuwait about 3 years of acute-care experience (both from secondary sources, not verified on official sites). Bahrain NHRA not verified. Not realistic before about 2029.

paths.name: UK PLAB 1 → PLAB 2 → GMC
paths.time: PLAB 1 can be taken now; full registration only after the internship
paths.note: Medical Training (Prioritisation) Act: regulations laid 15 Sep 2026 for training posts starting in 2027 give priority at both shortlisting and offer to UK, Irish and EEA-EFTA graduates, doctors who completed UK Foundation or the prior training stage, and British citizens / ILR / settled status holders. A fresh IMG on a visa is not prioritised, so PLAB now leads mainly to non-training (trust-grade) jobs first. Registration must be applied for within 2 years of passing PLAB 2. 2026/27 fee page not re-verified. Immigration rules HC 584 (stages 8 Oct, 29 Oct, 30 Nov, 9 Dec 2026) amend Skilled Worker — details not verified; Graduate route drops to 18 months from 1 Jan 2027. Ireland's Medical Council now accepts a PLAB 2 pass in place of PRES (confirmed 24 Oct), so PLAB also opens Ireland. HC 584 Skilled Worker changes from 8 Oct are mainly about modern-slavery victims and sponsor rules — nothing doctor-specific found. GMC (gmc-uk.org news, announced May 2026): PLAB 1 will no longer be held in Dhaka from February 2027 (also Alexandria, Accra, Chennai); overseas sittings drop from four to three a year. After that he must sit PLAB 1 in another country (e.g. one of the remaining Indian centres) or in the UK — extra visa and travel cost.
paths.change: GMC is ending PLAB 1 in Dhaka from February 2027, so later sittings mean travelling abroad (India or the UK) — the board had missed this May 2026 announcement.

paths.name: Ireland (IMC registration, HSE posts)
paths.note: The Bangladesh internship is not recognised as equivalent by the IMC, so he would register via the PRES route. Official IMC guidance now says applicants for General registration who pass PLAB 2 are exempt from PRES (PLAB 1 must be passed first; English language and fit-and-proper criteria still apply). If more than 3 years pass after PLAB 2 without practising, recency of practice is reviewed. So PLAB 1 + 2 doubles as Ireland's exam. PRES exam fees not re-verified.

paths.name: Australia AMC → AHPRA
paths.time: Hard to get a job without experience
paths.note: The AMC MCQ can be taken now. Registration needs a verified internship, and GP work needs RACGP/ACRRM fellowship. The Medical Board is reviewing two IMG pathways (Jun 2026) but there is still no generalist pathway for non-specialists. Re-checked 24 Oct: Medical Board pathways unchanged (Competent Authority, Standard, Specialist, Expedited Specialist); no new non-specialist route.

paths.name: Canada (MCCQE, CaRMS IMG stream)
paths.note: Most provinces reserve IMG residency places for citizens and permanent residents, so it's a dead end without PR. Practice Ready Ontario also needs Canadian citizenship/PR plus 4 years of family-medicine training and practice. Health Canada's Oct 2026 funding announcements for internationally trained physicians don't change the citizenship/PR requirement for residency.

paths.name: New Zealand NZREX
paths.note: Needs a pass in PLAB 1, AMC MCQ, MCCQE I or USMLE Step 1 and 2 within the last 5 years, plus IELTS/OET. His USMLE work doubles as NZREX eligibility. Expensive, with few places. Fees changed on 1 Jul 2026; Mar 2027 applications open since 1 Jul 2026.

paths.name: Germany Approbation (Kenntnisprüfung + FSP)
paths.cost: Blocked account €11,904/yr + €3–6k for language and exams
paths.note: Needs B2 general German plus C1 medical German. Law confirmed (BGBl. I 2026 Nr. 225, 28 Jul 2026), in force 1 Nov 2026: the standard route for non-EU doctors becomes language exam (FSP), then Kenntnisprüfung, then Approbation; document-based equivalence assessment only on request. Applications filed before 1 Nov run under the old law — irrelevant for him, as he needs the completed internship first. Revised ÄApprO publication not verified. Slow but reliable, and it pulls effort away from USMLE.

paths.name: Malta Foundation Programme
paths.note: Per the official FAQ, a non-EU citizen with a non-EU degree is ineligible.

paths.name: Other EU recognition (Italy, Nordics, Poland, Czechia, Hungary, Romania)
paths.note: Each needs degree recognition plus the local language. Italy: work 'in deroga' (without recognition) extended to 31 Dec 2027 per the Milleproroghe 2026 decree (reported by Quotidiano Sanità; not verified on an official gazette page) — needs an employer offer and regional authorisation.

paths.name: Erasmus Mundus: Europubhealth+
paths.note: No work experience needed (it only adds to the score) and medical graduates are accepted. Self-funded deadline 24 Mar 2027. The September 2027 start collides with the internship, so aim for 2028 or ask about late arrival. Interviews 18 Feb 2027.

paths.name: Erasmus Mundus: Infectious Diseases & One Health
paths.note: 2027–2029 cohort. The application-portal page gives 1 Dec 2026 – 15 Jan 2027; the homepage says only 'Dec 2026–Jan 2027'. Scholarship and eligibility details not re-checked. September 2027 start collides with the internship.

paths.name: Erasmus Mundus: MAIA (medical imaging + AI)
paths.dt: Not yet published ('Open soon'); EM window typically ≈Nov 2026 – Feb 2027
paths.note: Targets bachelor's holders in informatics, electrical/industrial/telecom engineering, maths or physics. Medicine isn't listed, so an MBBS is likely ineligible — confirm with the programme before investing time.

paths.name: Erasmus Mundus: full catalogue (37 new EMJMs, July 2026)
paths.note: Search the catalogue for public health, epidemiology, health data science, nutrition and tropical medicine. The weekly sweep adds individual programmes as they're confirmed. EU confirmed 37 new EMJMs on 16 Jul 2026 (first intake Sept 2027); examples with a health angle: Medical Image Analysis (MAIA), Advanced Microscopy with AI (MICROSCOM), IDOH Next.

paths.name: Gates Cambridge
paths.dt: 8 Dec 2026 or 6 Jan 2027, 23:59 UK, depending on course
paths.note: About 70 awards a year. Shortlist 8 Mar 2027, interviews 22–23 Mar, offers early Apr. The October 2027 start collides with the internship.

paths.name: Clarendon (Oxford)
paths.dt: 1 Dec 2026, 12:00 UK (MSc Global Health Science & Epidemiology)
paths.note: No separate form: applicants who apply by the December deadline and receive an offer are considered for Oxford scholarships (the page no longer names Clarendon specifically). Medicine degrees accepted. MSc GHSE overseas fee £36,900 (2027-28). MSc IHTM requires 3+ years' low-resource work experience, so it's out. 1 Nov re-check: the ox.ac.uk and NDPH course pages served older-cycle text and didn't show 2027-28 deadlines — 1 Dec date not re-verified; confirm on the Graduate Admissions page.

paths.name: Knight-Hennessy (Stanford)
paths.note: The 2027 cycle closed 6 Oct 2026, 1pm PT, with no extension. Re-open this card when the next cycle is announced (≈Oct 2027 for autumn 2028 entry, which fits after the internship). Degree must be earned in Jan 2020 or later (he qualifies), and he must also be admitted to a Stanford programme.

paths.name: KAUST fellowship
paths.note: Offers bioscience, AI and data science, but no clinical track. Round 2 opened 28 Sep 2026 and closes 3 Jan 2027; KAUST marks 2027 dates as tentative; decisions 25 Feb 2027; term starts 29 Aug 2027 (collides with the internship).

paths.name: Japan MEXT (Embassy recommendation)
paths.dt: Opens ~Apr 2027 via MoE advert; exact dates in the advert
paths.note: Must be born on or after 2 Apr 1992. An April or October 2028 arrival fits cleanly after the internship.

paths.name: Korea GKS Graduate
paths.note: The 2027 graduate guidelines haven't been published (only the 2027 undergraduate guidelines, 9 Sep 2026); last year's came out ≈Feb. The September 2027 start collides with the internship. Still not published as of 1 Nov.

paths.name: Stipendium Hungaricum
paths.dt: 2027/28 call not published; last deadline 15 Jan 2026, 14:00 CET
paths.note: Bangladesh is a Sending Partner. No experience rule stated. As of 1 Nov (unchanged from 24 Oct) stipendiumhungaricum.hu shows a maintenance page (Tempus sites down) and no 2027/28 call is confirmed; last year's opened ≈Dec 2025 with a 15 Jan deadline, so expect Nov–Dec 2026 (inference). Stipend won't cover living costs; budget for the gap.

paths.name: Türkiye Burslari
paths.dt: 2027 call not yet announced; usual pattern 10 Jan - 20 Feb (unconfirmed)
paths.note: Master's applicants must be under 30 (PhD under 35). Health-science graduate applicants need ≥90% academic performance — check his MBBS marks against this. Official calendar unchanged: general application period 10 Jan – 20 Feb.

paths.name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
paths.note: Allowance ≈CNY 2,500–3,500/month. No 2027 notice yet (embassy's latest is 19 Dec 2025 with a 10 Jan 2026 deadline via campuschina.org). As of 24 Oct still no 2027/28 Bangladesh notice (other embassies, e.g. South Sudan, have opened theirs). Watch the Chinese Embassy Dhaka and SHED in December. Still no Bangladesh notice as of 1 Nov.

paths.name: France Excellence Eiffel
paths.dt: Université Paris Cité internal deadline 29 Oct 2026, 23:59 Paris; other institutions vary (EHESP, Bordeaux ISPED not found); institutions file with Campus France by 6 Jan 2027
paths.note: Only French institutions can nominate; 'Biology and Health' is eligible. Master's applicants must be 29 or younger (born after 31 Mar 1997); PhD under 35. €1,200/month master's on the official programme page (unofficial reports of up to €2,100 not verified). Campus France's guide says 6 Jan 2027 but its news page mentions 8 Jan — results week of 12 Apr 2027. Re-confirmed 24 Oct on u-paris.fr: master's window 12–29 Oct, PhD window 12 Oct – 2 Nov; Paris Cité contacts its pre-selected candidates 1–4 Dec 2026.

paths.name: Commonwealth Master's / PhD (UK)
paths.dt: 2027/28 round closed 20 Oct 2026 (CSC); next call not announced
paths.note: Nomination via UGC Bangladesh only; UGC wanted a UK university offer letter with the hard copy. The CSC portal itself closes 20 Oct 2026, 16:00 BST, but only nominated candidates can use it, and UGC's internal deadline (30 Sep 2026) has passed. Stipend £1,712/month (£2,000 London) + fees + airfare. Plan the 2028 cycle: secure a UK offer by Sep 2027. UGC's 2027 notice still not found online.

paths.name: Chevening
paths.dt: Closes 6 Oct 2026, 11:00 UTC; earliest realistic cycle 2029/30
paths.note: Requires 2,800 hours of work after graduation; applicants without it are rejected outright. The 2027-28 round is now closed. Earliest realistic cycle 2029/30.

paths.name: DAAD EPOS (e.g. Charité International Health)
paths.dt: Each course sets its own (DAAD 2027/28 list)
paths.note: Requires at least 2 years of professional experience, so he's not eligible. The regular, self-funded Charité MScIH opens 15 Oct 2026 for Sept 2027 (over budget).

paths.name: DAAD Research Grants (doctoral)
paths.dt: Needs a doctorate already started; not open to a new MBBS graduate
paths.note: Mostly needs a German host professor.

paths.name: Fulbright (Bangladesh)
paths.note: Requires at least 2 years of full-time relevant experience and TOEFL 90 / IELTS 7. The J-1 visa carries the 212(e) two-year home rule.

paths.name: Australia Awards
paths.note: Around 3–4 years of relevant experience is expected, plus a 2-year return home afterwards.

paths.name: Swedish Institute (SISGP)
paths.dt: Programme list 13 Nov 2026; university application by 15 Jan 2027 (scholarship application follows in Feb)
paths.note: Bangladesh is eligible, but demonstrated work experience plus leadership experience are required (3,000 hours in past cycles). Public Health is an eligible field. Realistic only after ~2 years of post-internship work. 2027 dates from the SI call as summarised by Opportunity Desk; not re-read on si.se.

paths.name: Swiss Government Excellence
paths.note: Requires a completed master's first.

paths.name: Rhodes
paths.note: There's no Bangladesh route, and the Global constituency is suspended for 2026-27.

paths.name: NZ Manaaki
paths.note: Bangladesh isn't an eligible country.

paths.name: Holland, Italian DSU, Malaysia MIS, Singapore, IsDB, OeAD, MOE Taiwan (VLIR-UOS and TaiwanICDF excluded)
paths.dt: OeAD Ernst Mach 1 Dec 2026; MOE Taiwan 1 Feb-31 Mar 2027; others not published
paths.note: VLIR-UOS ICP: Bangladesh is not on the eligible country list. TaiwanICDF: Bangladesh not a partner country (MOE Taiwan Scholarship is separate: 2027 window 1 Feb – 31 Mar via the ROC overseas mission; NT$20,000/month graduate stipend + up to NT$40,000/semester tuition; mainly for diplomatic-ally countries with 'special consideration' for others; Bangladesh channel not verified). Invest Your Talent in Italy covers only engineering, architecture/design and economics. Holland Scholarship is a one-off €5,000. JDS Japan needs government-officer status. The rest are still unverified.

paths.name: Funded US PhD (epidemiology, biostatistics, informatics)
paths.dt: JHU and Harvard 1 Dec 2026 (Harvard 5pm); UNC 15 Dec 2026; JHU PhD Clinical Investigation 1 Mar 2027
paths.note: An MBBS is usually accepted for direct entry. JHU Epidemiology: GRE not required, TOEFL ≥100 / IELTS ≥7, 4 years of tuition + stipend. Harvard PHS: fully funded, GRE required for all applicants. UNC: GRE not required; files incomplete on 31 Jan aren't reviewed and department funding isn't guaranteed. By the end he'd be 7–9 years past graduation, which hurts a clinical Match; suits a research career.

paths.name: Salaried European PhD (NL, DE, Nordics, CH)
paths.note: This is employment and usually needs a master's. German medical faculties sometimes accept an MBBS.

paths.name: UK Wellcome / MRC doctoral programmes
paths.note: International places are limited by quota.

paths.name: Australia RTP PhD
paths.dt: Varies by university; Monash rounds 28 Feb / 31 Aug
paths.note: Usually needs research or honours experience; publications help.

paths.name: Paid US research post (J-1 or H-1B cap-exempt)
paths.note: The fastest real exit and the best bridge to a US Match: US letters and recent graduation. Avoid unpaid posts. Visa: J-1 research scholar is safest (ECFMG can sponsor if the host can't). H-1B $100k fee: Proclamation 11069 (18 Sep 2026) extends it to 21 Sep 2027, but a California court vacated the agency policies applying it on 30 Sep (government appealed to the 9th Circuit, 9 Oct) and a Massachusetts ruling also blocks it; appeals pending in the 1st, 9th and D.C. Circuits; as of 15 Oct no court had stayed the rulings (law-firm summaries; dockets not verified). The DHS $103,265 proposal's comment period closed 24 Sep with no final rule. DHS proposed (25 Aug 2026) an extra $103,265 fee for cap-subject petitions only — cap-exempt university employers wouldn't pay it. J-1 'duration of status' rule postponed by a court on 14 Sep. Keep his online presence clean before a J-1 interview. 1 Nov: no new court ruling found; university ISSS guidance (7 Oct) still says the fee is not being collected.

paths.name: Research posts in UK, Singapore or Gulf (KAUST, Sidra, HMC)
paths.note: His health data science work is the differentiator.

paths.name: NIH Fogarty LAUNCH global health fellowships (LMIC fellows)
paths.time: 11–12 months, mostly at an LMIC site
paths.dt: 2027-28 closed (deadlines 25 Sep – 1 Oct 2026); next call ≈summer 2027 for July 2028
paths.note: Seven Fogarty LAUNCH consortia fund 1-year mentored research fellowships. LMIC postdoctoral fellows qualify with an MBBS (not a master's), must be within 5 years of their degree, and must be resident in a country where the consortium has a site. Sites seen this sweep (GHES, NPGH LEADERs) don't include Bangladesh; other consortia not checked. Includes 1–3 months at the US mentor's university — US links and letters. Check each consortium's site list in mid-2027.

paths.name: Tuition-free German MSc (self-funded)
paths.cost: ≈USD 16–18k in year 1; about USD 30k for 2 years
paths.note: The only full degree that fits the USD 30k budget. Includes an 18-month job-search permit afterwards (not verified).

paths.name: US MPH / MS (self-funded)
paths.note: Over budget unless he gets an assistantship. STEM OPT covers epidemiology (26.1309) and biostatistics (26.1102), but a generic MPH usually isn't STEM.

paths.name: Australia MPH (self-funded)
paths.note: Over budget. The 485 post-study visa age cap is 35.

paths.name: UK 1-year MSc (self-funded)
paths.note: Over budget. The Graduate route drops to 18 months from 1 Jan 2027.

paths.name: Malaysia MPH (self-funded)
paths.note: Cheap, but the career payoff is limited.

paths.name: Nursing degree in Australia
paths.note: A false economy for medicine. AMC/AHPRA is still needed in full afterwards, and it adds nothing to US applications.

paths.name: NGO roles in Bangladesh (Cox's Bazar response)
paths.note: A springboard to international NGO work.

paths.name: MSF, IRC or ICRC international postings
paths.note: Needs 2+ years of experience after the internship.

paths.name: WHO / UN internships
paths.cost: Living allowance for eligible interns (per vacancy)
paths.note: Age 20+, enrolled or within 18 months of completing the degree, 3+ years of full-time study; 6–24 weeks, one time only; rolling vacancies via Stellis; living allowance for interns who need it (amount per vacancy). Check whether his internship rules allow a WHO stint. UNICEF (paid stipend, 2-year window) added separately. JPO/YPP need experience or donor nationality. Example: WHO HQ Ethics team internship (1 Feb – 16 Jul 2027) closed 23 Oct; shows how vacancies run on Stellis — they ask for current enrolment or recent graduation.

paths.name: Remote international work (medical writing, health-AI data work)
paths.note: Builds savings and CV alongside the internship. Top-paying AI 'medical expert' gigs (e.g. Mercor, $115–150/h) require board certification and an active licence — not open to him yet.

paths.name: CRA, pharmacovigilance or health-data jobs abroad
paths.note: Needs a CRO track record first.

paths.name: US observerships / externships
paths.note: Weak as US clinical experience. Bangladesh is on the B1/B2 visa-bond list (implemented 21 Jan 2026; final rule 3 Aug 2026): $10,000, $15,000 or $20,000 set at interview. The bond doesn't apply to J-1. Avoid Pathway 6 evaluators linked to banned vendors.

paths.name: Maldives, Seychelles, Pacific and African MOH recruitment
paths.note: Maldives MO pay: MVR 15,090 basic + MVR 275/working day + allowances. Needs MMDC-recognised MBBS, 12-month internship and 1+ year post-internship experience; agencies only. Watch the gazette from late 2028. Hospital-level MO calls keep appearing on gazette.gov.mv (e.g. Hulhumalé Hospital MO, due 18 Oct 2026) — all ask for post-internship experience.

paths.name: Cruise ship / offshore doctor
paths.note: Needs emergency medicine or GP experience.

paths.name: Foreign defence medical schemes
paths.note: Requires citizenship.

paths.name: Caribbean "licensing shortcuts"
paths.note: Misinformation: there is no legitimate shortcut to US practice.

paths.name: Japan / Korea medical licensing
paths.note: Requires native-level language plus the national exam.

paths.name: Erasmus Mundus: Public Health in Disasters (PHID)
paths.cost: Free with EM scholarship (€1,400/month); self-funded partner-country fee €18,000 total
paths.note: Health degrees accepted; no work-experience minimum (relevant experience scores 0.2 points per month, up to 3 points). IELTS 6.5 with 6.5 writing (TOEFL iBT 79). 25 fee waivers across 4 intakes. September 2027 start collides with the internship — ask about late arrival, or use the 2028 cycle.

paths.name: Erasmus Mundus: LIVE_Innov (vaccinology)
paths.dt: MyLIVE application platform open 18 Nov 2026 – 20 Jan 2027 (Sept 2027 intake)
paths.note: Clinicians explicitly accepted; no work experience required; English C1 (IELTS 6.5). Lyon / Barcelona / Antwerp. Vaccinology rather than data science. Homepage (1 Nov) gives 18 Nov – 20 Jan; last sweep's 19 Nov – 21 Jan came from an older page — use the earlier dates.
paths.change: Programme homepage now gives the 2027 application window as 18 Nov 2026 – 20 Jan 2027 (one day earlier than previously listed).

paths.name: Erasmus Mundus: Human Response (humanitarian health & displacement)
paths.note: Needs a 180+ ECTS bachelor's; IELTS 6.5 (no band under 5.5) or TOEFL 92; no application fee. Selection weights: academic level 30%, relevance 15%, research 5%, professional experience 20%, statement 20%, cohort fit 10% — experience counts but isn't required. Humanitarian and global health focus. Sept 2027 start collides with the internship; ask about late arrival.

paths.name: LSHTM Fund Scholarship (MSc)
paths.note: For low- and middle-income country nationals, including Bangladesh; no minimum work experience stated. Excellent for MSc Epidemiology. A 2027 start collides with the internship; the 2028-29 round is the realistic one.

paths.name: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme
paths.note: 400 awards; no nationality or work-experience limit; stipend HK$344,400/yr + HK$14,400 travel for 3 years. RGC initial application closes 1 Dec 2026, 12:00 noon HKT; university applications (CityU, HKBU, HKUST, HKU, etc.) close 1 Dec 2026, 11:59pm HKT. Normal start Jul–Sep 2027, but RGC allows deferral to 31 Jan 2028 for well-justified reasons — ask the university early. Whether an MBBS meets each PhD entry rule varies (HKU wants a research master's or a strong 4-year bachelor's) — ask CUHK/HKU public health first.

paths.name: NUS Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health PhD (NUS Research Scholarship)
paths.cost: Free + S$3,000/month (S$3,500 after qualifying exam), tuition waived, no bond
paths.dt: Aug 2027 round closed 1 Nov 2026 (no extension; off-cycle only for self-financing applicants); Aug 2028 round ≈1 Nov 2027 (not announced)
paths.note: An MBBS is explicitly accepted for direct PhD entry. IELTS 7.0. A confirmed thesis advisor is mandatory before applying. Funded entry is August only (Jan intake = self-funded, case by case), so if Aug 2027 clashes with the internship, target the Aug 2028 intake (deadline ≈1 Nov 2027). Re-checked 1 Nov: no extension; off-cycle applications are considered only for self-financing applicants, case by case.
paths.change: The Aug 2027 funded round closed 1 Nov 2026 with no extension; the next realistic target is the Aug 2028 round (≈1 Nov 2027).

paths.name: A*STAR SINGA (PhD in Singapore)
paths.cost: Free + S$2,700/month (S$3,200 after qualifying exam) + S$1,000 settling-in + S$1,500 airfare
paths.dt: Aug 2027 intake: 1 Dec 2026; Jan 2028 intake: 1 Jun 2027 (window 2 Dec – 1 Jun)
paths.note: PhD at NUS, NTU, SUTD or SMU in science and engineering only. The Jan 2028 intake (deadline 1 Jun 2027) fits right after the internship.

paths.name: NTU Research Scholarship (incl. Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine)
paths.dt: LKCMedicine PhD: Aug 2027 intake 1 Oct – 31 Dec 2026; Jan 2028 intake 1–30 Jun 2027
paths.note: Needs a supervisor's agreement and Honours (Distinction) or equivalent. NTU Research Scholarship stipend not re-verified. The Jan 2028 intake (June 2027 window) fits after the internship. Backup to NUS.

paths.name: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship (ESOP)
paths.dt: Apply 1–30 Nov 2026, closes 30 Nov 11:59 CET (for autumn 2027)
paths.note: Top 10% of the bachelor's class; thesis pre-proposal needed; no work-experience rule; about 60 awards. The Nov window is mandatory for non-Swiss degrees. Whether ETH master's programmes (Health Sciences & Technology, Data Science) accept an MBBS is not verified. Long shot; 2028 cycle is more realistic.

paths.name: Karolinska KI Global Master's Scholarship
paths.cost: Tuition only — Stockholm living costs on him
paths.dt: Scholarship window 8–24 Feb 2027 (results 26 Apr 2027); programme application ≈mid-Jan 2027
paths.note: KI must be ranked first on universityadmissions.se. Programmes include Public Health Sciences and Global Health. Weak on a USD 30k budget.

paths.name: Monash Graduate Scholarship (research degrees)
paths.dt: Int'l rounds: R1 closes 28 Feb 2027; R3 opens 4 May, closes 31 Jul 2027 (Science/Arts pages)
paths.note: PhD entry usually needs research/honours experience; publications matter.

paths.name: Brunei Darussalam Government Scholarship
paths.note: Age limit 35 for master's (age counted at 31 July before the deadline). Last cycle closed 15 Feb 2026, 23:59 Brunei time (confirmed via a partner-government page; Brunei MFA page didn't load). Academically weak fit but a safe fallback.

paths.name: Mayo Clinic Research Fellow posts (e.g. AI & Informatics, Jacksonville)
paths.note: Mayo 'Research Fellow' posts take 'PhD, MD or equivalent' and allow at most one prior postdoc. Current MD-eligible postings: Immunology (Oh lab, Scottsdale, ID 390313) and Dermatology (Wyles lab, Rochester, ID 393086 — PhD preferred; MDs need substantial research and publications). A Jacksonville Neuroscience post (ID 393271) wants a computational PhD. He qualifies once the MBBS degree is conferred; set Mayo job alerts — posts close fast.

paths.name: MGH International Research Fellowship (Trauma & Emergency Surgery)
paths.cost: Year 1 unfunded (external funding expected); year 2 may be funded
paths.dt: 2026 deadline 16 Oct passed (no extension); next cycle ≈Oct 2027 (not announced)
paths.note: Closed for this cycle (deadline 16 Oct 2026, no extension). Non-US applicants encouraged; 2–4 fellows a year. Year 1 not funded by the division; year 2 possible but not guaranteed; visa processing 3–6 months. Next cycle (≈Oct 2027) would line up with the end of the internship, but year-1 costs would eat most of the budget.

paths.name: Cleveland Clinic congenital heart surgery research fellowship (HVTI)
paths.dt: 2026-27 round closed 31 Jan 2026; next round not published, email to ask
paths.note: Foreign graduates welcome; H-1B or J-1; paid salary + benefits for 1 year. Only the 2024–25 flyer exists; email villwos@ccf.org to ask about the current cycle. No green-card sponsorship for trainees.

paths.name: UNICEF internships
paths.cost: Paid monthly stipend (+ possible travel lump sum)
paths.note: Open to students and graduates within 2 years of graduation. Check whether the Bangladesh internship rules allow it.

paths.name: OIST PhD (Okinawa), 2027 Admissions Workshop round
paths.cost: Free: ≈¥2.6M/yr rising to ≈¥3.6M (tuition included); ¥5,000 application fee
paths.time: 5 years; entry 1 May 2027, 1 Sep 2027 or 1 Jan 2028
paths.note: Bachelor's 'or equivalent' required; the page doesn't mention MBBS, so confirm and check which faculty have supervision places. A 1 Jan 2028 entry fits right after the internship. Campus housing ≈¥21,600/month.

paths.name: Imperial College President's PhD Scholarships 2027–28
paths.cost: Free: full fees + £27,036/yr for 3.5 years + £2,000/yr consumables
paths.dt: Round 1 closed 2 Nov 2026; round 2 closes 11 Jan 2027, round 3 on 1 Mar 2027
paths.note: 50 awards, any nationality. Needs a supervisor's agreement first and a first-class degree or equivalent; some departments can't take international students. This is the funded route into Imperial's School of Public Health epidemiology PhD (its own studentship is home-fee only). Earliest funded start 1 Aug 2027, latest 1 Nov 2027 — a 1 Nov start fits the internship end. Round 1 (2 Nov) results by 31 Jan 2027; round 2 (11 Jan) by 15 Apr; round 3 (1 Mar) by 31 May. Stipend £27,036 (2027-28).

paths.name: ISTA PhD Program (Institute of Science and Technology Austria)
paths.cost: Salaried: €3,053–3,673/month gross ×14, no tuition or application fee
paths.dt: 8 Jan 2027, ≈15:00 CET (page also says 14:59 — submit earlier)
paths.note: Bachelor's holders are eligible; fields are biology, neuroscience and computational science. MBBS acceptance not stated — ask phd.admissions@ist.ac.at. September 2027 start collides with the internship.

paths.name: Edinburgh Doctoral College Scholarships (e.g. Global Health PhD)
paths.cost: Free: fees + UKRI-rate stipend (£21,805 at 2026-27 rate) for 3.5 years
paths.dt: PhD admission 9 Nov 2026; scholarship form 2 Feb 2027 (Health in Social Sciences page; other schools vary)
paths.note: Open to overseas applicants; 2:1/first or equivalent; a PhD application must be submitted first. 6 awards in the College of Medicine & Veterinary Medicine. Recheck in November. 1 Nov re-check: the registry page served 2026-27 content only; 2027 deadlines not verified.

paths.name: Wellcome Sanger Institute 4-Year PhD
paths.cost: Free: fees + stipend (£25,649 yr 1, rising to £27,385 yr 4, at Oct 2026 rates); visa and NHS surcharge reimbursed
paths.note: 12 funded places, any nationality; genomics and data science. Degree requirements aren't listed — ask the Postgraduate Programme Office whether an MBBS qualifies. Oct 2027 start collides with the internship. Interviews 25 Jan 2027; no word by 11 Jan means not shortlisted.
paths.change: Stipend updated to Oct 2026 rates: £25,649 in year 1, rising to £27,385 in year 4. Deadline unchanged: 24 Nov 2026, 09:00 GMT.

paths.name: Erasmus Mundus: NOHA International Humanitarian Action
paths.note: 16 scholarships for 2027, max 10% per nationality. Experience isn't required but weighs heavily — winners usually have humanitarian field experience, so his odds are low. Degree must be relevant to humanitarian action (medicine plausibly is); C1 in the language of instruction. Confirm with nohamasters@deusto.es. Sept 2027 start collides with the internship. Confirmed 1 Nov on nohanet.org: 2027–29 call opened 1 Oct 2026; EM scholarship deadline 15 Dec 2026, 23:59 GMT; degree must be finished by that date.

paths.name: Erasmus Mundus: imAGEin (biomedical & computational sciences in ageing)
paths.note: Needs a 180-ECTS bachelor's or 'equivalent STEM diploma'; medicine isn't named — email eur-life.imagein@univ-cotedazur.fr. Biomedical/computational focus suits a health-data interest. Sept 2027 start collides with the internship.

paths.name: Flemish Government Master Mind Scholarships

Study in Flanders says the scheme is under review for 2027-28, so the grant and rules may change. Host deadlines page still shows last cycle (KU Leuven 15 Jan 2026). Whether health master's (e.g. Antwerp ITM, Ghent) qualify isn't stated.

paths.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship
paths.dt: 2027 call not announced (2026 closed 12 Mar 2026; usual window late Jan - mid Mar)
paths.note: No work-experience rule. Needs an offer from an Irish university first. €10k won't fully cover Dublin living costs.

paths.name: Czech Government Scholarships (developing countries)
paths.dt: 2027/28 window closed 30 Sep 2026; next call not published
paths.note: Bangladesh was eligible for English-taught programmes. This year's deadline is missed; the next round (for 2028/29) fits after the internship.

paths.name: Mahidol University Graduate Scholarship (MUGR)
paths.cost: Tuition up to THB 20,000/semester; Central Quota adds THB 10,000/month living
paths.dt: 2027 rounds not published (2026 rounds: Jan, Mar, May, Jul)
paths.note: CGPA ≥3.25 and IELTS 5. Faculty of Tropical Medicine, Siriraj and Ramathibodi are excluded; public health programmes are not. Cheap but low payoff for the US goal.

paths.name: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme
paths.note: Bangladesh is eligible. Half the award is a loan, which strains a USD 30k plan.

paths.name: EMBL International PhD Programme
paths.dt: Winter call closed 12 Oct 2026; Summer 2027 call opens ≈end Jan 2027
paths.note: Needs a degree that qualifies for a PhD in the country where it was earned. The Summer 2027 call (opens ≈end Jan) is the realistic next shot.

paths.name: Vienna BioCenter PhD Programme
paths.dt: Autumn call closed 15 Oct 2026; spring call usually 1 Mar – 15 Apr (2027 not posted)
paths.note: Needs a master's, or a 4-year first-class bachelor's with research experience; MBBS eligibility unclear. Next call is the realistic one.

paths.name: NIH Visiting Program (Visiting Fellow)
paths.dt: No deadline; find an NIH lab first
paths.note: NIH policy 2300-320-3: PhD, MD or equivalent; ≤5 years of postdoctoral research (plus typically up to 2 years of non-research clinical training); NIH sponsors the J-1. Whether a Bangladeshi MBBS counts as MD-equivalent isn't confirmed — ask DIS@mail.nih.gov. NIH letters would be strong for the Match.

paths.name: ECFMG J-1 Research Scholar sponsorship
paths.cost: EVSP fees page (27 Feb 2026): $370 annual application fee (whether it applies to Research Scholars not verified) + SEVIS $220 + J-1 visa $185
paths.dt: Apply once a US host offers a post
paths.note: Lets a US lab without its own J-1 designation host him for research with no or incidental patient contact; USMLE/ECFMG certification generally not required. May carry the 212(e) two-year home rule if US or Bangladeshi government funding is involved.

paths.name: University of Arizona COM–Phoenix International Research Fellowship
paths.cost: $120 application + $1,200/yr programme fee + visa fees; unpaid (living ≈$20k+/yr, estimate)
paths.note: J-1 sponsored US research with letters. Some departments require USMLE Step 2. Unpaid, so it would consume most of the budget in about a year; check whether the J-1 carries 212(e).

paths.name: GWU Medical Research Fellowship Program for IMGs
paths.note: Asks for USMLE scores. Fee and visa support not stated — email impinfo@gwu.edu. Unpaid.

paths.name: UNFPA Global Internship Roster 2026
paths.cost: Monthly stipend for interns without outside funding (varies by duty station)
paths.dt: Roster closes 31 Dec 2026, 23:59 New York (Job ID 31319)
paths.note: Open to those starting within a year of graduation. Needs English or French plus the local office's language. Check whether the internship rules allow a break.

paths.name: Gavi Internship Programme
paths.cost: Fixed stipend (amount not stated); travel and housing on him
paths.note: Must be within 12 months of finishing the degree, so it clashes with the internship window unless a post comes up right after it.

paths.name: Erasmus Mundus: IMIM (International Master in Innovative Medicine)
paths.cost: Free with EM scholarship (amount not stated on page)
paths.time: 2 years from Sep 2027 (Groningen, Heidelberg, Tartu, Uppsala)
paths.note: 'Medicine' is a listed eligible field (180 ECTS equivalent); no work experience needed, research experience is a plus. 2027 requirements marked 'under review'. Translational research focus — strong fit for an MBBS. Sept 2027 start collides with the internship; ask about deferral.

paths.name: Erasmus Mundus: SpaceMed (physiology & medicine in space and extreme environments)
paths.cost: Free with EM scholarship (stipend amount not stated)
paths.time: 2 years from Sep 2027 (Charité Berlin, Slovenia, Caen)
paths.dt: Portal opens 21 Oct 2026, closes 21 Jan 2027; results early Apr 2027
paths.note: A medical degree is named as an accepted background; no work-experience rule found. Niche field. Sept 2027 start collides with the internship.

paths.name: Erasmus Mundus: Neurasmus (European Master in Neuroscience)
paths.note: About 20 places from 800+ applicants; no work-experience rule found; medicine plausibly fits neuroscience but isn't confirmed — check the admission page. Sept 2027 start collides with the internship. A self-funded call also runs 19 Nov 2026 – 20 Feb 2027 (10:00 CET). 1 Nov re-check: the key-dates page served only old 2025 content — 1 Dec date not re-verified.

paths.name: Erasmus Mundus: HYGIEIA (health & wellbeing across the lifespan)
paths.cost: Free with EM scholarship (amount not stated)
paths.time: 2 years from Sep 2027 (Lisbon, Belgrade, Balearic Islands)
paths.dt: 2027 dates not on programme site (last call mid-Nov to mid-Feb)
paths.note: Prevention, nutrition and lifestyle focus. Page doesn't say whether a medical degree fits (health background likely). Sept 2027 start collides with the internship.

paths.name: Eu-HEM European Master in Health Economics & Management
paths.cost: Self-funded: about €9,000 a year participation cost for non-EEA students; no Erasmus Mundus scholarship
paths.note: Health economics and management, taught across Oslo, Rotterdam, Innsbruck and Bologna. The programme's FAQ states: 'Unfortunately the EMJM scholarship is not available for this programme.' Non-EEA participation costs are about €9,000 a year (Erasmus University Rotterdam page, as reported by Muse). Not a fit for a $30k budget that has to cover USMLE costs. Non-EU applications run through Oslo (about 15 Oct – 1 Dec 2026).
paths.change: Eu-HEM's own FAQ says the EMJM scholarship is not available for this programme, so it moves from funded study to self-funded.

paths.name: Erasmus Mundus: MemBioMed (membrane biology to experimental medicine)
paths.cost: Free with EM scholarship (amount not stated)
paths.note: Eligibility not shown on the page. Lab-science focus. Sept 2027 start collides with the internship.

paths.name: Yenching Academy, Peking University

paths.note: GPA 3.0+, IELTS 6.5, no work-experience minimum. Whether an MBBS counts isn't stated — ask admissions.chls@hbku.edu.qa. Funding is not guaranteed.

paths.cost: Full tuition + monthly allowance + round-trip airfare

paths.note: Age ≈34 or under, GPA 2.30/3.0+, English CEFR B2; must contact a supervisor first. Separate from the Embassy-recommendation route. 1 Oct 2027 start clashes with the internship by about a month — ask about an April 2028 start.

paths.name: University of Glasgow GREAT Scholarship 2027
paths.note: Bangladesh eligible; work experience OR proven interest in the subject is enough; public health included. Partial award — the rest of a UK MSc is over his budget.

paths.note: Bachelor's holders may apply to the Schools generally. The new Max Planck School of Biomedical AI wants a master's in CS, maths, statistics, engineering, physics or computational life sciences — MBBS not mentioned. No work-experience rule. Sept 2027 start collides with the internship.

paths.name: MBZUAI MSc/PhD (incl. Computational Biology)

paths.name: Hartford Hospital General Surgery Research Fellowship

paths.name: Jefferson Otolaryngology Research Fellowship
paths.note: For recent MD/DO graduates; J-1. Ask Elizabeth.Kangas@jefferson.edu which positions are funded and whether an MBBS counts.
